column1: # comment: Language alignments — schema.org + Wikidata. gmeow:Language is registry-INDEPENDENT (a self-minted IRI); these are see-also links, and coreference of language INSTANCES to Lexvo (http://lexvo.org/id/iso639-3/…), Glottolog and Wikidata items is asserted in data with skos:exactMatch + gmeow:authorityLink, not here. Proficiency scales (CEFR/ILR/ACTFL), writing-system roles, version lineage, origin/modality/status value vocabularies and the WritingSystemUsage relator are largely CANONICAL — no maintained external RDF vocabulary covers them faithfully. The reified gmeow:LanguageProficiency flattens to schema:knowsLanguage / wdt:P1412 only via the EDOAL+FnO projection layer, not by a 1:1 SSSOM claim.
